name: Scabbard Ring
body:
Price 12,400 gp; Slot ring; CL 5th; Weight — lbs.; Aura strong transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This ring consists of a thin lead wire wrapped in strips of hardened red leather. The scabbard ring allows its wearer to transfer a single one-handed weapon to their forearm in the form of a tattoo. Transforming a weapon to or from tattoo form requires a full-round action. The scabbard ring can only have one weapon in tattoo form at a time. Should the ring be removed while a weapon is in tattoo form, the tattoo will fall over the arm and revert to its original form.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 6,200 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells shrink item
